stubs.service: Electron main process (all window.api IPC: library DB, playlists, play stats, config store, hotkeys, downloads, updater, cache, streaming, plugins, Last.fm status)
stubs.how: The real preload (electron/preload/index.ts) is bundled into the browser build with `electron`, `os` and `@electron-toolkit/preload` aliased to small fakes (.ui-capture/web/fake-*.ts); ipcRenderer.invoke/send are routed to an in-page fake main process (.ui-capture/web/main/*.ts) that returns the same shapes as the real IPC handlers, backed by .ui-capture/web/seed.json.

stubs.service: Rust native audio engine (audio-engine via player:* IPC)
stubs.how: Silent simulated player (.ui-capture/web/main/player.ts): load/play/pause/seek/volume work and position events are pushed at 5 Hz on a wall clock; no audio output. Output devices are a fixed list (MacBook Pro speakers, AirPods Pro, FiiO K7).

Offline stand-in in .ui-capture/web/main/netease.ts: login_status reports a guest (not logged in); discover endpoints return a small set of playlists/artists/albums built from the local seed; anything else returns a 503-style 'network unavailable' error so those sections hide.

stubs.service: QQ Music / Kugou APIs, lyric matching services, AMLL TTML DB, comments, OpenCC, motion covers, song recognition
stubs.how: Handled in the fake main process: return empty/null results (lyrics not found, no comments, identity conversion).

stubs.service: Cover art and artist photos (normally cover:// protocol extracted by Rust / fetched online)
stubs.how: Generated abstract SVG covers and avatars written by the seed generator to .ui-capture/out/covers/ and referenced as /covers/<hash>.svg.

notes: SPlayer-Next is an Electron app; only its Vue renderer is shown, built as a static site with `.ui-capture/build.sh` (runs the seed generator, then `vite build --config .ui-capture/web/vite.config.ts`, which reuses the renderer config from electron.vite.config.ts and only injects the browser preload shim before src/bootstrap.ts). Dependencies were installed with `.ui-capture/install.sh` (pnpm 11 because pnpm 12's store lock can't be created in this sandbox; electron-builder is dropped by .ui-capture/pnpmfile.cjs since its packages contain files the sandbox forbids and it's only for packaging). Data (generated by .ui-capture/seed/generate.mjs): a local library of 285 tracks / 44 albums / 45 artists (Chinese, Japanese and Western albums with real tracklists, FLAC + MP3, a few untagged loose files in ~/Downloads), 10 local playlists (including an empty one and a 'to sort' one), 42 liked songs, ~1600 play events over the last 8 months feeding the Stats page, 180-entry play history, a download list (done/downloading/queued/failed/canceled), and a restored play queue (playlist '深夜写代码', track 4 paused mid-song). Timestamps are shifted to the current time on load. Renderer-side state (liked ids, history, queue in IndexedDB; status in localStorage) is written through the app's own localforage stores on first open (before the app mounts). Main areas: Home (#/), Library (#/library), Liked (#/liked), History (#/history), Stats (#/stats), Folders (#/folders), Downloads (#/download), local playlists (#/collection/local/playlist/<id>), artist/album lists, search, the full-screen player, and Settings (modal).
